shared_elements: patterned coiffure rendered as rows of curls
low relief bust or full figure facing right or left in procession
garment with fringed or patterned edging
stylised almond eye shown frontally in a profile head
justification: Both depict bearded male figures in strict profile with the same highly conventional treatment — beard and hair built from regimented rows of tight curls, a frontal almond eye set in a profile head, an earring, and a fitted cap — which is a specific, arbitrary set of conventions unlikely to arise independently. The main difference in content is scale and composition: A is a single close-up bust dominating the field, while B is a full-length procession of figures carrying vessels and holding hands, set above a border band of rosettes, with no comparable framing or narrative in A.
